Encounter.Name: Ongoing Negotiations
Encounter.DescriptionText: You hail the Syndicate captain. After a few moments a crackling voice answers over the subspace channel:

Message.Text: Ah, if it is not our ADJ1 SING friends! Have you grown tired of our attention? Ready to pay? I am afraid our expenses have gone up lately, so our price has gone up too.
Wonderful news! We will let you know when we have drunk our way through your money. Until then, sleep safe.
Then why waste my time? Syndicate out.
You are as foolish as you are ADJ2. You still do not have the credits, SING. Call us when you do.
